description: Upload an image file from local disk as a Google Ads image Asset (for Display banners / Responsive Display Ads). Returns the asset resource_name to reference in an ad. Refs #5744.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var.

filePath.description: Absolute path to a PNG/JPG image file on disk (<150KB, standard IAB size).

name.description: Asset name (must be unique in the account).

name: gads_upload_image_asset
